intent: Dashboard picks up repositories registered from a terminal
notes: A repository registered while the Dashboard was running (by `gator gatorize` or `gator init` in a terminal) was listed in Add Repository, but adding it failed with "Already registered", and it stayed out of Fleet until the Dashboard restarted (#108). The Dashboard read the registry file only at startup.
Add now succeeds for such a repository and shows it in Fleet. "Already registered" now means the Dashboard already shows it.

Add Repository and Refresh now reload the registry file when it has changed. A repository registered from a terminal no longer appears as one to add, and Fleet refreshes to show it. A repository removed from a terminal leaves Fleet on the next refresh.
